title: Recording: Get On The Right Thing by Wings | 1970
content:
Studio B, CBS Studio Building, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney

Paul McCartney recorded ‘Get On The Right Thing’ on 14 October 1970.

Although it appeared on Wings’ Red Rose Speedway album, it was recorded during the Ram sessions, and completed the following November.

During this session McCartney played piano and sang a guide vocal part, with David Spinozza on guitar and Denny Seiwell on drums. Spinozza also overdubbed some backwards guitar.
